name: logi-command-importer
description: Discover namespaced VS Code commands and import them into the Logi Command Manager catalog used by Logi Options+.

commands.title: Logi Command Importer: Find and Replace in Catalog
Logi Command Importer: Open Active Logi Catalog

logiCommandImporter.namespacePrefixes.markdownDescription:
Command ID prefixes to search for, e.g. `"git."`, `"workbench.action."`, `"myExtension."`.

Example: `["myExtension.", "workbench.action."]`

logiCommandImporter.displayNameOverrides.markdownDescription:
Map of command ID to an explicit display name, overriding inferred names.

Example: `{ "myExtension.doTheThing": "Do The Thing (Legacy)" }`

logiCommandImporter.groupNameOverrides.markdownDescription:
Map of command ID to an explicit Logi group name, overriding the derived default.

Example: `{ "myExtension.doTheThing": "My Extension" }`

logiCommandImporter.subGroupRules.markdownDescription:
Rules mapping a command ID prefix to a subgroup name, one `prefix|subGroupName` pair per line. The longest matching prefix wins.

Example: `myExtension.insert|Insert Commands`

logiCommandImporter.sourceExtensionFilte.markdownDescription:
Extension IDs to search by, in addition to namespace prefixes — every command from these extensions is included, regardless of namespace. Pre-fills the "Search by extension" picker; empty means no extension-based search by default.

Example: `["somePublisher.myExtension"]`

logiCommandImporter.selectedByDefault.markdownDescription: Whether newly imported catalog entries are marked `"selected"` by default.

logiCommandImporter.displayNameFindRepla.markdownDescription:
Literal find/replace rules applied to *inferred* display names on every future import (never to an explicit `displayNameOverrides` entry), one `find|replace` pair per line. For a one-off cleanup of names already in the catalog, use **Logi Command Importer: Find and Replace in Catalog** instead.

Example: `MyExtension: |` (finds `"MyExtension: "` and replaces it with nothing)

logiCommandImporter.groupNameFindReplace.markdownDescription:
Literal find/replace rules applied to *derived* group names on every future import (never to an explicit `groupNameOverrides` entry), one `find|replace` pair per line. For a one-off cleanup of names already in the catalog, use **Logi Command Importer: Find and Replace in Catalog** instead.

Example: ` for VS Code|` (finds `" for VS Code"` and replaces it with nothing)
